---
name: code-reviewer
description: Use this skill to review code for security vulnerabilities and quality issues, and to assess whether a given code segment is safe, robust, and production-ready.
---

- Make sure the OWASP Top 10 security risks are not present in the code

  Follow these steps:

- fetch the current OWASP top 10 
- list all the top 10 security risks and check if any of them are present in the code
- give a single score per risk from 0 - 10
- and lastly an overall score at the end for all the top 10.

- Check for code quality and maintainability
